rule_definitions.friend_base: foreign prev-5 net sell then buy, total inst > 0, MACD hist improves, near MA60 support, not above MA20 chase, volume 0.25x-1.5x 20D average, no >4% chase day
rule_definitions.friend_strict: base-like but requires prior 5 straight foreign sell days, dealer non-negative, 2-day MACD hist improvement, above MA5, volume <=1.2x 20D, daily return <=2.5%
rule_definitions.friend_loose: foreign or total institutional turn-buy, MACD hist improves, price 0.95x MA60 to 1.08x MA20, volume <=2x 20D, daily return <=6%
rule_definitions.friend_pullback_limit: prior-day support setup with previous foreign selling, price near MA60, non-spike volume, no chase, MACD hist >= -2.0; next day limit buy at min(MA60*1.005, close*0.98) only if touched
